reference.owner: yes its good put it as the topic's reference
reference.use: Our own finished film, picture and sound approved by the owner. Build like it. Never retell it.

origin.what: The Roblox video the format was taken from. The numbers in `film` come from measuring it. Studied, never copied.

models.note: Finished films the owner approved, to build like. The first is the topic's reference film. Each is kept with its source and its mp4 in Topics/InThisTown/reference (README.md there lists them). Copy how they are built; never copy their story.
models.in-this-town-same-face: THE REFERENCE FILM (see `reference`). Script shape (short cut), shots, kit use, and sound. The owner: 'everything is perfect top to bottom', then 'yes its good put it as the topic's reference'. Page, source and mp4: Topics/InThisTown/reference/same-face.
models.in-this-town-nobody-looked-at-the-moon: A film at night, and a remake of a rejected 20-second film (short cut, 63 shots). The owner: 'every single one u made is good'. Page, source and mp4: Topics/InThisTown/reference/nobody-looked-at-the-moon.
models.in-this-town-monster-egg: The long cut (18 beats, 93 shots). Voice only: it was made before the sound rule. The owner: 'every single one u made is good'. Page, source and mp4: Topics/InThisTown/reference/monster-egg.
models.in-this-town-superpower-at-18: The long cut with sound (90 shots), from the owner's own outline. The owner: 'wow i love it, i love how u made the short'. Page, source and mp4: Topics/InThisTown/reference/superpower-at-18.

voiceOnly.in-this-town-monster-egg: It was built before the sound rule; its sound sheet is not written yet.

measuredFromOrigin.note: The treehouse video has music under every second of it. Its quietest 8% of 20 ms frames (the gaps between words, where only music is left) are 20.7 dB under its loudest 40% (speech). The same measure on in-this-town-same-face reads 22: our music is a little further back.

measuredFromReference.note: The mix of the reference film, as scripts/sound.py measured it (src/videos/in-this-town-same-face/sound.lock.json).
